# ProgressBar

How far along a piece of work is, when that is known — and that it is running, when it is not.

## Anatomy

A label row with an optional figure, over a bordered track carrying the fill.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number` | — | 0–100. Leave undefined for work whose extent is not known yet. |
| `label` *(required)* | `string` | — | — |
| `valueText` | `string` | — | The figure beside the label — "3 of 12", "48%". Text, so it can be translated. |

## Variants

Determinate and indeterminate.

## States

Both variants; the indeterminate one is stilled under reduced motion.

## Keyboard

Not interactive.

## ARIA

`role="progressbar"` with `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin` and `aria-valuemax` when the extent is known, and `aria-valuetext` carrying the caller's wording. An indeterminate bar omits the value attributes, which is how that state is expressed.

## Accessibility acceptance criteria

- Reachable, operable and leavable by keyboard alone, with a focus indicator meeting 3:1 in both schemes.
- An accessible name for every control, and current state exposed programmatically.
- No meaning carried by colour alone.
- Legible and operable at a 360px viewport and at desktop width, and at 200% zoom.
- Interactive targets at least 44 × 44px on touch-capable viewports.

## Reference correspondence

None. The reference has no progress indication of any kind. The track takes the sunken surface and the control-contrast boundary its filled fields use, and the fill takes the ink its active states use.

## Recorded deviations

None.
